title: gh auth login --with-token accepts a token without the advertised workflow scope
`gh issue create --type` creates the issue, then exits 1 with `type "X" not found` without printing its URL (causes duplicates on retry)
`gh skill update` help incorrectly promises to preserve locally added files
gh pr close <URL> --delete-branch can force-delete a same-named branch in an unrelated repository
`gh pr merge <url> --delete-branch` removes a worktree and deletes a same-named branch in the cwd's unrelated repository
